HARD-PORT GLIDE-TURN — Full-span glide transitioning to a sixty-degree banked left turn, right wing dropping near-vertical, left wing rising, tail fanning hard sideways, the inner wingtip grazing a ledge-face and shearing off a shower of loose scree.

COURTYARD DIVE-SLAM — Body slamming from a near-vertical dive onto a paved courtyard, all four limbs absorbing impact simultaneously, radial shockwave cracking the paving outward in all directions, wings snapping full-open at the precise moment of contact.

BANKING STALL-TURN — Wing-over at the apex of a hard climbing turn, outer wing fully extended as pivot axis, inner wing swept back tight, tail fanning to bite air, body hanging momentarily broadside against the open sky.

CLOUD-PUNCH VERTICAL — Body in near-vertical ascent punching through a cloud layer, a circular hole torn in the overcast behind, spinning vapour-rings trailing upward, wings at the absolute peak of a full-power upstroke.

MOLTEN-POUR BREATH — Throat interior incandescent amber, expelling a slow viscous stream of superheated material in a parabolic arc downward, each contact-point below erupting in secondary bursts of spreading orange fire and boiling stone.

GROUND-LEVEL ARCH-DISPLAY — On all fours, neck arching steeply upward in a high curve before sweeping the head back down to ground-level, wings half-cocked and slowly fanning, each beat raising a halo of dust and loose stone.

SPIRAL TOWER ORBIT — Banking in a tight descending helix around a crumbling tower, wingtip nearly brushing the stonework on each pass, downwash dislodging gargoyles and loose masonry that spiral into the vortex below.

BROODING COIL — Body folded in a compressed coil atop a broken fortress wall, one wing draped partially open like a canopy, head resting on the foreleg, nostrils venting slow twin wisps of smoke, one eye half-open and scanning.

LIGHTNING-ARC WALK — Body advancing forward on all fours mid-stride, jaw hinged wide and discharging a sustained blue-white arc that scorches a continuous furrow into the stone floor ahead, dorsal spines rigid and corona-lit.

RIDGE SPRINT LAUNCH — Body transitioning from a full four-legged sprint along a ridge into a launch, hindlegs shoving off the ridge-edge, forelegs clawing air, wings mid-first-explosive-downstroke, a spray of dislodged ridge-stones falling behind.

MAGNETIC HOVER-LOCK — Wings spread rigid and vibrating at high frequency, body suspended in place above a glowing glyph-pillar, arcs of energy visibly bridging between the pillar-top and the ventral chest-plates, loose debris floating upward beneath.

INVERTED GLIDE-PASS — Body fully inverted in level flight, wings maintaining extension with ventral-side toward sky, head craned downward to track a target below, tail fanned wide for pitch-stability, ground-shadow thrown upward against a low cloud-base.

RAIN-CLOUD DESCENT — Body angling steeply down through heavy rain, wings half-furled into a delta configuration, water streaming off every trailing edge in white ribbons, jaw slightly parted, inner throat-glow reflecting orange against the rain-curtain ahead.

STONE SPUR FULL-GRIP — All four limbs locked to a vertical cliff-face, talons buried in fissures at four separate anchor-points, body hanging away from the rock, head turned ninety degrees to fix on a distant airborne target, wings pressed flat to the spine.

BROODING COIL — Body compressed in a low coil atop a broken fortress wall, one wing draped partially open like a canopy, head resting on the foreleg, nostrils venting slow twin wisps of smoke, one eye half-open and scanning the approach.

LIGHTNING-ARC ADVANCE — Body moving forward mid-stride on all fours, jaw hinged wide and discharging a sustained blue-white arc that scorches a continuous furrow into the stone floor ahead, dorsal spines standing rigid and corona-lit.

RIDGE SPRINT LAUNCH — Body transitioning from a full four-legged sprint along a ridgeline into a leap, hindlegs shoving off the edge, forelegs clawing open air, wings mid-first-explosive-downstroke, a spray of dislodged ridge-stones falling in the wake.

GLYPH-PILLAR LOCK — Wings spread rigid and trembling at high frequency, body suspended above a glowing rune-pillar, visible arcs of energy bridging between the pillar-top and the ventral chest-plates, loose debris rising slowly in the field below.

INVERTED GLIDE-PASS — Body fully inverted in level flight, wings holding extension with ventral-side toward sky, head craned downward to track a target below, tail fanned wide for pitch-stability, ground-shadow thrown upward against a low cloud-base.

RAIN-CURTAIN DESCENT — Body angling steeply through heavy rain, wings half-furled into a delta configuration, water streaming off every trailing edge in white ribbons, inner throat-glow reflecting orange against the rain-curtain directly ahead.

CLIFF-FACE STATIC CLING — All four limbs locked to a vertical rock-face at four separate anchor-points, body hanging away from the stone, head rotated ninety degrees to fix on a distant airborne target, wings pressed flat against the spine.

MAGNETIZED HOVER-DRAG — Forebody tilted skyward, hindlegs dangling, wings thrashing asymmetrically to counter a lateral pull, a column of upward-rushing arcane light gripping the ventral scales and bending the whole body toward its source.

FROZEN SURFACE STALK — Body low and horizontal, all four legs moving in slow deliberate silence across flat glacial ice, wings folded flush, each footfall leaving a spiderweb crack radiating from the talon-point, breath misting forward in slow pulses.

SIDE-SLIP EVASION — Body snapping into a near-horizontal side-slip, one wing driving hard down while the other angles steeply up, a crossbow bolt visible passing through the vacated airspace, tail torquing violently to correct the yaw.

VORTEX PULL-OUT — Body wrenching out of a tight spinning dive, wings snapping to full extension against the centrifugal load, primary feathers bending rearward under the strain, a cone of compressed disturbed air unwinding visibly below the tail.

MONUMENT CRUSH — Forelegs wrapped around a stone obelisk in mid-hover, talons sinking into carved granite, the column fracturing in a circumferential ring and the top half beginning to tilt, wings beating hard to hold position against the resistance.

SHADOW-WING SPREAD — Wings thrown fully open in total darkness, the membrane surfaces faintly luminous with a deep violet inner light, body hovering motionless, the glow casting the dragon's own silhouette as a double-shadow onto the ground far below.

HEADLONG CHARGE — Body at full gallop across open ground, neck stretched horizontally ahead, wings half-open and beating for speed rather than lift, each stride cratering the earth and the impact-shockwave visible as a ripple racing ahead through the soil.

UPDRAFT STALL — Wings cupped and driving upward in a braking flare, body pitched nearly vertical with the tail swinging forward, a column of compressed air punching downward from beneath the wings and cratering loose scree in a perfect circle below.

RUNE-SPINE IGNITION — Body stationary on a ledge, all dorsal spines suddenly erupting with sequential glyph-light racing from tail-tip to skull-crest, each spine becoming a separate pillar of amber fire, the air between them crackling with discharging energy.

WATER-SKIMMING GLIDE — Wings locked full-span, body descending to within a meter of a lake surface, the downwash pressure-wake dragging a furrow of foam across the water directly below, wingtips leaving two thin white lines at the outermost edges.

BROADSIDE HOVER-ROAR — Body hanging in mid-air broadside to the viewer, wings in synchronised mid-beat, head thrust laterally outward from the neck at full extension, jaw open and venting a concussive sound-blast that flattens the water surface below.

SNATCH-AND-ASCEND — Hindlegs fully extended downward mid-flight, talons locked around a large carved stone idol, wings driving hard upward in a deep labored downstroke, the idol's base still trailing dust and mortar from being torn free of its plinth.

OBSIDIAN SHELF PRESS — Body braced on a narrow obsidian shelf, forelegs overhanging the edge, hindlegs locked, neck curved steeply downward over the drop, one wing spread for balance and the other folded, gaze fixed on something moving far below.

FROST-CONE WALK — Advancing forward on hindlegs only, forelegs drawn back, frost-breath streaming continuously from the wide-hinged jaw, the frozen ground spreading ahead of each step in a widening fan of white rime, spine-spikes rigid with cold.

THERMAL BREAK-OUT — Body punching free from the top of a thermal column, wings suddenly transitioning from tight-banked wheel to full-extension glide, the updraft-column visible as a swirling dust-pillar below, wingtip feathers shaking loose in the burst.

RUINED ARCH PERCH — Body settled onto the keystone of a collapsed archway, both hindlegs dangling on either side of the curve, wings folded asymmetrically, head lowered between the shoulders and jaw resting on the stone, one eye tracking the horizon.

STONE TEMPLE DESCENT — Body dropping vertically between two temple pylons, wings folded into near-zero profile, the stone columns cracking outward from the pressure-wave, hindlegs extending for touchdown, tail fin scraping a groove down one pylon face.

ARCANE BREATH-HELIX — Hovering with neck outstretched, the exhaled fire-stream twisting itself into a slow rotating helix mid-air, each spiral band branded with glowing sigil-marks, the rotating column tightening and accelerating toward a target ahead.

CLIFF-TOP PROWL — Walking slowly along the extreme edge of a cliff on all fours, body angled slightly outward over the drop, tail extended for counterbalance, one foreleg swinging out over empty air with each step, head scanning the valley below.

HAMMER-DIVE ABORT — Wings snapping open from a full peregrine-stoop at the last possible moment, the ground-blast of the near-miss throwing a radial dirt-ring outward, body pulling into a steep climb, talons still trailing inches above the cratered earth.

GLYPH-CROWN DESCENT — Descending slowly in a near-vertical drop with both wings raised and angled inward like a closing fist, a crown of activated rune-rings stacked above the skull and rotating at different speeds, each ring tightening as the body drops.

WING-MEMBRANE TEAR RECOVERY — Body torquing in mid-flight to compensate for a torn wing-membrane, one wing driving at full stroke while the other holds a reduced angle, altitude bleeding in a controlled spiral, the damaged panel trailing a visible flutter.

BOULDER-TOP VIGIL — Seated upright on a massive isolated boulder, hindlegs folded beneath the body, tail wrapped around the base, wings fully closed and pressed against the flanks, neck held at full vertical extension, head slowly rotating a full hemisphere scan.

CHAIN-LIGHTNING EXHALE — Neck rigid and forward-extended, jaw wide, a bolt of lightning exiting the throat and striking a stone battlement, then jumping to a second target, then a third, each hop leaving scorch-craters and suspended debris at the strike-points.

FOREST-FLOOR STALK-FREEZE — Body locked mid-step in the shadow of the forest floor, one foreleg raised and suspended, neck horizontal, eyes narrowed to slits, absolute stillness except for the slow lateral sweep of the tail-tip and a single curl of nostril-smoke.

SUMMIT WIND-BRACE — Standing four-legged on a mountain summit in a near-horizontal gale, wings half-spread and angled forward into the wind as living sails, body leaning hard into the blast, loose snow and debris streaming horizontally off the peak behind.

HAMMER-STALL — Dragon arrests vertical climb at apex, wings snapping perpendicular to spine in full-stop hover, loose feathers and ice crystals exploding outward in a pressure ring from the sudden braking force.
